The '''GK-600 guardian droid''' was a defense [[Droid/Legends|droid]] programed to protect set perimeters. [[Cornelius Evazan/Legends|Cornelius Evazan]] used two of these droids to protect his lab during his experiments involved with the [[Project Starscream]].
